title: Light Turns Beer Into Something Close To Skunk Spray
hook: Light does not spoil beer by warming it. It breaks it chemically.

cast.note: Bill is a curious drinker, not a connoisseur. The chemistry is the star.

scenes.note: State the claim boldly — light BREAKS beer — then earn it.

beats.action: brown bottles line up on a counter; Bill picks one up
the brown glass highlights; a clear bottle appears beside it
a beam of light strikes the clear bottle and the liquid visibly shifts

scenes.note: Establish the stable state so the reaction has something to disrupt.

beats.action: the liquid magnifies into molecules drifting calmly in darkness
the hop compounds sit still and label themselves; nothing moves

scenes.note: THE mechanism. Riboflavin is a MIDDLEMAN — it must visibly receive light and pass energy on.

beats.action: blue and ultraviolet light enters the molecular field
a riboflavin molecule absorbs the light and brightens
it hands the energy across to a hop compound in a visible transfer arc
more light enters the field and finds the riboflavin
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the transfer arc brightens as the energy passes across
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: The break, then the reveal. The skunk comparison is chemical, not a joke — keep the drawing factual.

beats.action: the energy arrives at the hop compound and strains it
the compound splits apart into fragments
the fragment redraws beside a matching molecule labelled from skunk spray; the two are identical
a NOT A METAPHOR stamp lands beside the pair
the fragments drift apart and settle into their new arrangement
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.note: Three bottles, three outcomes. Brown blocks, green partly, clear not at all. Hard cut.

beats.action: brown, green and clear bottles line up under the same light
light stops at the brown glass; the beer behind stays intact
some light passes the green glass; a little reaction starts inside
Bill sniffs the green bottle and pulls a face; hard cut
